text:
nina: FYI I just onboarded a new hire and they copied the quickstart from examples/quickstart/README.md and hit a runtime error. Snippet drift again.

omar: what error? paste the snippet/error if you have it.

nina: error is `TypeError: createClient is not a function`. README still uses `createClient({ apiKey: ... })` but the JS SDK moved to `new RedwoodClient({ token: ... })`.

lee: oh that mismatch will be super confusing for newcomers. The python example also uses `client = Redwood(api_key=...)` which is inconsistent. We should pick a canonical param name in docs (token) and the env var REDWOOD_API_KEY.

pat: also noticed the README code block shows `import { createClient } from 'redwood-sdk'` but package was renamed to `@redwood/inference` in the latest example repo. Two separate drifts: API surface and package name.

nina: exact problematic JS block from README:
```js
import { createClient } from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
```

nina: changing to this fixes it:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
```

omar: good. please also add a short callout about header format for curl examples. I keep seeing `-H 'x-api-key: $KEY'` across repo examples. Standardize on `-H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY'`.

lee: I'd like to add a docs-lint that scans for common removed identifiers: createClient, setApiKey, redwood-sdk. Regex-based checks are fine as a first pass.

pat: can we also add a small GH Action that runs a tiny Node script to require the package and call the example function (with sandbox mode) so we catch runtime import/name changes? Could run on PRs to /examples and on a monthly schedule.

nina: +1. That would have caught the package rename. I'll draft the action.

omar: note for support: update KB article KB-210 to reference REDWOOD_API_KEY and show snippets for Node/Python CLI. That way support and docs are aligned.

pat: i'll prep a single PR that: fixes README snippets (curl/node/python), adds regex lint to docs CI, and a lightweight GH Action which executes the Node example in sandbox. Will include a short note about retries: "SDK performs transient retry/backoff; avoid doubling app-level retries unless idempotent."

lee: also suggest adding a small line about token naming and rotation so customers don't paste in stale keys.

pat: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/431 . Changes: package/import fixes, env var normalization to REDWOOD_API_KEY, curl header update, docs-lint regex, and node smoke test action.

doc-bot: Created DOC-1499 to sync Quickstart templates and KBs; scheduled monthly snippet-run workflow.

nina: thanks. once PR lands i'll run through the onboarding checklist and update the internal starter repo.

omar: great work. this should cut down the "it broke on first run" tickets. closing thread. :rocket:
